row.notes: Looks up key in the package object at pkg_ref+8 (sorted lookup via Vm_Find_PkgObjectKey_Thunk or linear scan of 12-byte entries when count field >= 0x1000000). If the entry offset has bit 31 set it resolves the referenced object (Vm_PkgObj_ResolveRootOffset) and reads key hash 0x425ed3ca from it, otherwise reads the value directly with Ne_PackedTable_ReadValueById (type desc 0x145660540). Returns the 32-bit value, 0 on failure with errno set (3 = not found).
